tweets.text: The U.S. Border Patrol is a team built on vigilance, integrity, and service to our country. United by our commitment, duty, and respect for the oath we have sworn, our ranks reflect the communities we protect. Our agency takes pride in the men and women from all backgrounds who have chosen to uphold the law, defend our borders, and safeguard our homeland. Every agent stands shoulder to shoulder with one mission: to protect the nation, protect our communities, and enforce the law with honor and professionalism.
